meta.title: Wetherspoons Bristol: Pub locations and menu guide
meta.description: Find Wetherspoons Bristol pubs in City Centre, Harbourside and Clifton. Compare locations, understand local pricing and check breakfast and club days.

intro: This guide covers {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Bristol across {areaCount} areas, helping you choose a location and plan what to order. Every pub works from the national [Wetherspoons menu](/), but prices are set locally. Find The Commercial Rooms in City Centre, The V-Shed in Harbourside and The W. G. Grace in Clifton. Alongside the pub list, we explain local pricing, typical breakfast hours and traditional club days so you can check the details that matter before visiting.
quickAnswer: We list {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Bristol: The Commercial Rooms in City Centre, The V-Shed in Harbourside and The W. G. Grace in Clifton. These cover {areaCount} areas, so start with the location that suits your plans. The menu is broadly shared nationally, but each pub sets its own prices, making a local check worthwhile before ordering.

areas.text: The Commercial Rooms is the listed Wetherspoons pub in City Centre, on Corn Street. It suits visitors whose plans are already in this area and who want to choose a pub without changing locations. Check its current menu prices rather than assuming they match another Bristol branch.

The V-Shed is the listed Wetherspoons pub in Harbourside, with an address at The Waterfront, Canons Road. Choose it if Harbourside is the most convenient area for your visit. The national menu provides a starting point for food choices, but confirm current dishes and prices with the pub.

The W. G. Grace is the listed Wetherspoons pub in Clifton, on Whiteladies Road. It suits anyone looking for a pub in this area rather than City Centre or Harbourside. Compare its current menu with your preferred order in mind, as prices are set by each pub.

pricing:
Wetherspoons menu prices in Bristol are set pub by pub, even though the food menu is broadly the same nationally. Popular national choices include [burgers](/burgers), curries, fish and chips and pizza, but confirm the current selection at your chosen branch.

City centre pubs often charge more than suburban pubs, so a central location can mean a higher bill. That general pattern does not establish which Bristol pub is cheapest, and any guide prices should be treated as typical rather than fixed.

For an exact price, check the chosen pub's current menu or ask at the bar before ordering. When comparing branches, compare the same dish rather than assuming every item differs equally.
breakfastAndClubs:
Breakfast at Wetherspoons is typically served from eight in the morning until noon, so that is the usual window to plan around in Bristol. The traditional breakfast is among the popular dishes on the national menu. Confirm the local serving times with your chosen pub, particularly if breakfast is the main reason for visiting.

[Curry Club](/curry-club) is traditionally on Thursday and [Steak Club](/steak-club) on Tuesday at participating pubs. Check participation and current details with The Commercial Rooms, The V-Shed or The W. G. Grace before making plans around a club day.
